Language.String: Real Glass & Water could not draw its glass on this computer, so it has switched itself off: nothing in this city is changed by it.\n\n The mod needs Metal or OpenGL 3.3, and the game does not have either here. If the game is started with a launch option that changes its graphics (Steam: right-click the game, Properties, Launch Options), remove it and restart the game.

Real Glass & Water could not draw its glass on this computer, so it has switched itself off: nothing in this city is changed by it.

 The mod needs OpenGL 3.3, and the game does not have it here. If the game is started with a launch option that changes its graphics (Steam: right-click the game, Properties, Launch Options), remove it and restart the game.

 The Windows version of the game runs the mod through Proton: Steam, right-click the game, Properties, Compatibility, check "Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool" and pick a Proton version.

Real Glass & Water could not draw its glass on this PC, so it has switched itself off: nothing in this city is changed by it.

 The usual causes:
 - the game is started with a launch option such as -force-d3d9, or -force-glcore on a graphics card whose OpenGL is older than 3.3 (Steam: right-click the game, Properties, Launch Options). Remove it, and restart the game.
 - the graphics card is older than DirectX 10.

 If neither applies, please report it on the mod's Workshop page, with this file:

Real Glass & Water settings.
 
 You can edit this file while the game is running: the mod reads it again within a second of it being saved, and the panels follow.
 
 - Numbers use a dot for decimals: 0.5, never 0,5.
 - A percentage is written the way its slider shows it: 47 means 47%.
 - A value outside its range is pulled back into it. A value that cannot be read, and a name the mod does not know, are ignored. RealGlass.log says which.
 - A setting whose line is missing keeps the value it has (at startup, its default).
 - If the file cannot be read at all, the mod leaves it alone and says so in the log.
 - The mod rewrites this file, these comments included, whenever a setting changes in the game: notes of your own will not survive.
 - Delete the file with the game closed to start again from every default.
{0}. A key such as F8 or Ctrl+Shift+G, or None; default {1}.
{0}. A color, #RRGGBB (42, 92, 120 is read too); default {1}.
